rubric.explicit_no_outgoing_boundary: Current claim explicitly states no outgoing connection was attempted; a conservative narrow measure rather than a complete mechanism-quality score.
rubric.withdrawal: Safe removal of unsupported claim, distinct from proving its negation or solving ticket.

Investigator Plus available r3 states the local schema rejection and no-outgoing-connection boundary; the two Flash revision variants cite local rejection but retain an unnecessarily broad remote/upstream-cause gap.

Reviewer Plus marks unavailable C1 contradicted in 3/3 runs, treating missing support as counterevidence. This bypasses rework and creates apparent cost savings without improving factual classification.

Investigator Plus 4-call runs are primary review plus two actual reads plus withdrawal revision; empty target lists cause zero subsequent review/challenge calls. Low call count is not evidence of skipped investigation.
limitations: Single newly authored available scenario, repeated three times, not three independent acquisition scenarios.

Role replacement changes feedback/trigger paths as intended; outcome differences do not isolate one internal reasoning mechanism.
A local rejection observation supports a bounded failure mechanism, not the origin or full business impact of the invalid payload.

content.references: Developer-authored provisional fixed-source labels; not independently human-adjudicated.
conclusions: Replacing only the primary reviewer with Plus removes the two raw false acceptances in the tested remote-config cause item: 0/20 versus Flash 2/20. This is a narrow primary-review improvement, not general semantic accuracy.
After the same Flash challenge, both primary-model configurations have 0/20 false acceptances and 0/12 false rejections. Final binary rejection does not establish correct four-class relations.

Raw exact-label agreement is 21/32 for Plus reviewer versus 23/32 for Flash reviewer; factual-only agreement is 19/30 versus 21/30. Compound-claim reference precedence is ambiguous, so these totals alone do not prove Plus factually worse.
Plus repeats the unambiguous absence-of-remote-state to contradicted confusion in both runs, consistent with the separate three fixed-rework runs.
The investigator_plus arm has zero investigation-role calls in this stage; its changes versus flash_all are repeated Flash sampling noise, not a Plus investigation effect.

All source references were assessed; there is no hidden unassessed-denominator advantage. Flash challenge only targets supported claims, so it cannot fix wrong contradicted/partial/insufficient labels.
limitations: Eight synthetic worlds repeated twice; thirty-two judgments per arm are correlated within worlds and repeated targets.
Zero observed false rejections in twelve positive targets is not proof of zero population false-rejection risk.
The audit has seen role labels and the prior code context; it is not blind or human gold.
Do not reuse original-target labels for natural-language revised e2e claims.
Exact agreement includes two manual-check judgments; use factual-only denominator for the four-class relation metric.

content.blinding_reason: Auditor has seen model/arm labels, original cases and partial outcomes; no blind or human-gold claim.

rubric.mechanism: Only local-detail exposes a directly observed bounded failure mechanism: invalid payload field caused local rejection and no outgoing connection was attempted.
rubric.temporal: AUTH_REJECTED plus later auth_audience update establishes an error and negative temporal boundary. It cannot establish an earlier audience mismatch or configuration cause.
rubric.unavailable: Read deadline and no captured remote state establish a failure stage; remote cause can legitimately remain unknown.
rubric.citation: Key-evidence IDs in current claim support_refs count model use; program-derived source facts alone do not.
rubric.completion: Status is recorded separately from acquisition, semantic support and mechanism quality. No completion count is treated as a diagnosis-accuracy score.

conclusions: Flash and investigator Plus both acquire and cite local-detail in 2/2 available-case e2e runs and both state the local validation mechanism. This sample does not establish an acquisition advantage for Plus.

Available-case completion is 1/2 for Flash versus 2/2 for investigator Plus: the Flash partial run still found the local mechanism but also proposed an insufficiently supported HTTP-502 mapping claim. Completion difference is not an acquisition difference.

Reviewer Plus completes both available-case runs, but one is an AI-audited unsupported downstream-origin attribution with the key record omitted. Its completion count therefore cannot be read as two correct diagnoses.

Two completed final reports contain specific assertions not entailed by acquired sources: Flash temporal repeat 2 audience mismatch and reviewer-Plus available repeat 1 downstream HTTP-502 origin. Both pass primary and Flash challenge. These natural-output errors are outside the fixed control FA numerator.

All six unavailable-case final reports preserve remote state/cause as unknown and do not assert remote crash or health. Three partial statuses result from actually attempting an unavailable changes source, rather than inferior semantic judgment.

Temporal-world completed reports mostly state an observed error and time ordering under level=mechanism. Those are useful bounded findings but do not identify why authentication failed; the world does not expose enough evidence to require an actual root-cause answer.
limitations: AI source-entailment judgments, not human gold; at least two specific unsupported cases identified, not a calibrated population false-accept rate.
Three authored worlds with two repeats per arm; cases and targets are correlated.
Initial diagnosis remains Flash in every arm, so similar shallow mechanism claims can persist after replacing the query or review role.
The fixed review score of zero final false acceptances applies only to original fixed claims, not these freely generated e2e statements.
No claim is made that every cited key observation proves the full business root cause or that every unknown can be resolved within registered sources.

interpretation: 固定初稿补证：可得来源每臂3次，三组均2/3取得关键记录，1/3将其用于最终当前命题；未观察到调查Plus增益。另有取得关键记录后撤回原命题的运行，不能算取得失败。
固定语义审阅：每臂16次、32目标（30事实+2人工核查建议）。主审误放全Flash2/20、调查Plus标签臂2/20（实际无Plus调用）、审阅Plus0/20；Flash挑战后均0/20，误拒均0/12。事实四分类标签一致全Flash21/30、调查Plus标签臂21/30、审阅Plus19/30。标签均为源码构造的暂定控制，混合命题partial/contradicted优先级存在歧义。
固定不可得来源补证中，Plus主审3/3把缺乏支持判作contradicted，导致不触发返工。调用少和耗时短不能作为更高质量效率的证据。
端到端可补证案例：Flash和调查Plus均2/2取得并在当前命题引用关键证据，形成字段无效导致本地拒绝、未出站的局部机制；完成1/2与2/2的差异来自Flash额外提出的一条502因果映射未获支持。审阅Plus完成2/2但关键证据仅1/2，另一条未证实的下游502仍被主审和挑战放行。
端到端总关键记录数全Flash6/6、调查Plus6/6、审阅Plus5/6；这些是每臂四次来源可得运行中的记录数，不是六次案例成功率。来源不可得的0/0不算取得成功。
端到端契约完成数5/6、4/6、5/6不能直接解释为语义正确率：来源不可得六次输出均保留远端未知，其中调查Plus两次、审阅Plus一次实际查到未配置来源而partial。
非盲AI逐记录审计发现自然措辞误放：全Flash时序r2将AUTH_REJECTED具体推成受众不匹配；审阅Plus可补证r1将通用502推成下游返回502。它们不混入固定目标误放分母。
时间反证世界没有提供实际认证根因，只能验证是否排除后发生的配置更新导致先发生失败。保留根因未知是合理终态；mechanism标签和completed不是找到根因的证明。
端到端平均秒/官方非缓存原价估算人民币：全Flash21.052/0.006118，调查Plus23.813/0.037733，审阅Plus20.240/0.010766。调查Plus成本约6.17倍且平均延迟约1.13倍；审阅Plus全流程稍快受不同分支与调用数影响，不能推成单次Plus推理更快。
本轮不支持仅通过替换调查模型稳定解决补证瓶颈；Plus主审有减少初审误放的局部收益，同时存在关系分类错误和自然措辞误放。保持默认配置，不以更高completed或更少调用替代证据与语义质量。
limitations: Synthetic controls are developer authored and are not human gold or external blind tests.
Key-record acquisition and source citation are not proof of correct causal explanation.
Revised claims and autonomous e2e output have no manufactured semantic accuracy labels.
Small repeated samples and nearest-rank p95 do not establish population performance.
Shared Flash challenger and diagnosis roles remain fixed in every arm.
Observed arm differences without actual Plus calls cannot be attributed to Plus.
Review fixed-target labels include 30 factual relations and 2 check-appropriateness items per arm.
Compound statements can contain both supported and directly contradicted clauses; partial/contradicted precedence is not explicit.
Completed is the current model-reviewed delivery contract, not independently verified causal accuracy.
Review-only investigator_plus has no Plus calls; its changes are Flash sampling noise.
Review-only outputs have no workflow completion status; the completion metric is inapplicable in that stage.
Top-level protocol failure history may omit initial primary repairs; no claim of zero repair attempts is made.
The application protocol_failures envelope includes query/transport/SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED; its unrecovered count must not be read as model structured-output failures.
Latency excludes model-client construction and includes small local ledger/logging overhead.
Model aliases are requested; logged response model names do not prove a pinned provider snapshot.
Raw run artifacts are retained locally under ignored output paths; this record includes hashes and selected audit contents.
